## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why. Link the related issue, for example `Closes #123`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one topic
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] The development checks from CONTRIBUTING.md pass
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed

## New providers only

- Which official upstream evidence is used?
- How are failures or stale evidence handled so they stay `unknown` instead of showing as supported?
